scope: Governed transitions materially affecting rights, entitlements, eligibility, employment, credit, licensing, disciplinary status, or essential/public services where governing authority requires contestability or redress.
added_requirements: Challenge scope and standing must be represented where required.
Successful challenge propagation to affected models/packages/decisions must be traceable.
Post-consequence remediation semantics must be represented where applicable.
assurance_requirements: Test challenge initiation, review, correction propagation, and non-erasure of original decision provenance.
runtime_dependencies: Runtime/operating profile must define whether a challenge can stay or suspend commitment.
compatibility_rules: Profile does not create substantive appeal rights not present in source governance.
limitations: Draft profile requires domain-specific legal/institutional review.
